description.value: Nature's Fare Markets is a BC-based health food grocery chain with a well-established Kelowna location staffed by more than 75 employees, some with over 20 years tenure. The store carries certified organic produce, zero-waste bulk goods, vitamins, supplements, and clean beauty products alongside ethically sourced meat and dairy. An on-site Bistro serves local, organic, and sustainable foods, and grab-and-go salads, smoothies, and kombucha on tap make it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms address, phone, and active business status. It lists grab-and-go entrees, breakfast, smoothies, and an in-store Bistro ('Fuel up with local, organic and sustainable foods and drinks'), supporting hot/prepared food.
